message.text: The compiled React frontend is served via `go:embed` of the `dist/` assets. Echo static middleware serves the files, with an SPA fallback. The wiring is in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`. Registration happens from `server.go`.

The mechanism is `go:embed` of `dist/*` served as static files with SPA fallback. The wiring file is `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`.

`server.go` merely instantiates the router. The mechanism could alternatively be described as an embedded filesystem.

q27.
go:embed of `dist/*` served via Echo static + SPA fallback; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` loads the compiled React assets into `embeddedFiles`. `FrontendService.Serve` mounts them with `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware`. `server/server.go` calls `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
